description: This file contains internal data classes, enums, functions, and constants related to configuring and resolving gateways in the application. It handles parsing URLs and setup codes, validating security rules, and constructing gateway connection configurations. The code appears to be part of a module managing network gateway setup and validation logic within an Android application.
